_doc: Name-ambiguity pins — the durable fix for wrong entity matches. build-data consults these at read time; enrichers should prefer a pinned id over a name search. Keys are the scrobble artist name. Fields: mbid/spotify/discogs = canonical ids; clearStyles = drop this artist's (wrong) Discogs styles; clearLife = drop its (wrong) MB life-span; origin/life/gender = hard overrides; react = force the Reactivated badge (hand-curated ledger: band killed by death/breakup then returned); tmExclude = TM name-match is a wrong entity, skip it; bio = hard-override the last.fm/Discogs bio; tags = hard-override the tag chips; dropTags = filter these (collision) tags out; note = why.

Bleach.bio: Bleach were an all-female punk/rock trio from Okinawa, Japan, active from 1998 to 2009. Fronted by vocalist-guitarist Kanako, they built a following on the Japanese underground scene with fast, hooky garage-punk before disbanding in 2009. The name collides with the UK shoegaze Bleach, a German house act and an American Christian rock band.
Bleach.note: Japanese punk band (Okinawa, 1998–2009). Name collides with German house + shoegaze Bleach. tmExclude kills a false-positive Ticketmaster match ("BLEACH (It) Tribute to NIRVANA", an Italian Nirvana tribute act). last.fm bio was multi-band disambiguation text describing the UK shoegaze Bleach; overridden here. "anime" tag is a franchise collision — dropped.

Linkin Park.note: Ended 2017 after Chester Bennington's death; returned 2024 with new vocalist Emily Armstrong. MB still lists them active — life override marks the 2017 hiatus so the Reactivated badge reads right.

Alice in Chains.note: Dormant after Layne Staley's decline (inactive ~2002, died 2002); returned 2005–06 with William DuVall. MB still lists them active — life override marks the dormant period.

Nevermore.note: Disbanded 2011; Warrel Dane died 2017. Reunited 2025 with founders Jeff Loomis and Van Williams plus a new lineup (first show in 16 years). MB still lists them active — life override marks the 2011 breakup.

daine.note: Melbourne hyperpop artist. Discogs matched a wrong classical 'Daine' (Baroque/Organ) — was polluting the Style-Atlas Organ row.

Brutus.note: Belgian post-hardcore trio (formed ~2013). MB matched an unrelated 1960s act → bogus 'since 1966' elder.

Loathe.note: Liverpool metalcore/shoegaze band (formed ~2014). MB matched an unrelated Maltese 'Loathe' → wrongly placed the map bubble in Malta.

Bloodywood.note: New Delhi folk-metal band. MB matched a wrong Chinese entity → the bubble landed in China.

Lisa.note: This is LiSA (Risa Oribe), the Japanese anime-tied singer (Gurenge, ADAMAS, dawn) — stylized LiSA. Enrichment collided with same-name artists: the Discogs image is the American Lisa and the Spotify image is BLACKPINK's Lisa; neither is correct, so the image is left as-is (no correct local candidate). Tags overridden to drop the collision (hip-hop/k-pop) and read as j-pop/j-rock/anime.
